# Plugin.Maui.HttpForge

Type-safe, source-generated HTTP REST client for .NET MAUI. Declare an API as a C# interface; HttpForge generates the HttpClient implementation.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.HttpForge
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.HttpForge
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-httpforge
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+), net10.0-maccatalyst (15+), net10.0-windows (10.0.17763+; packed on Windows and merged into the published nupkg)

Platforms: Android, iOS, Mac Catalyst, and Windows.

## Current release

1.1.0. Source-generated REST client plus query objects, collection formats, naming presets, [Timeout]/[Url]/[PathPrefix], optional segments, [QueryName]/[FormObject], IAsyncEnumerable streaming (JSON Lines / SSE), request compression, and AuthorizationHeaderValueGetter (absolute URI). Optional Testing, Newtonsoft.Json, and XML packages. Reflection fallback is not planned. Compare with Refit 15: Docs/refit-comparison.md.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.HttpForge

Registration: `UseHttpForge` / `AddHttpForgeClient<T>` — see README.md.

Compose retry / cache / tokens / resume on the same `IHttpClientBuilder`: Docs/integration.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I generate a typed REST client in MAUI like Refit?
- How do I declare GET/POST interfaces and let the compiler build HttpClient calls?
- How do I upload multipart from MAUI without writing HttpRequestMessage by hand?
- How do I flatten query objects, collection formats, or camel/snake/kebab keys?
- How do I stream SSE or JSON Lines as IAsyncEnumerable<T>?

## Do not use when

- The team already standardized on Refit
- You need retry, cache, token refresh, or resumable uploads — see ApiResilience, ApiCache, SecureSession, SmartUpload
- The protocol is not HTTP REST
